title: A bioinspired electrocatalyst for CO2 electroreduction to ethanol via secondary-sphere synergy in Fe porphyrinic-based metal–organic frameworks
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,6823-6831
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01388G, Paper
Kaian Sun, Shaohui Xie, Ping Guan, Zewen Zhuang, Xin Tan, Wei Yan, Jiujun Zhang, Chen Chen
An enzyme-inspired Fe–porphyrin MOF catalyst with secondary-sphere functionalities enables efficient and selective CO2 electroreduction to ethanol via tilted *CO adsorption and proton-shuttled hydrogenation through hydrogen-bonding networks.
